# Devzery

> Devzery is an AI-powered API testing automation platform that integrates with CI/CD pipelines to streamline regression testing and QA workflows.

Devzery provides intelligent API testing solutions with SDKs for multiple programming languages (Node.js, Java, Python, Golang) and seamless integration with popular development tools like GitHub Actions, Jenkins, and Jira. The platform combines automated test case generation with regression testing capabilities to help development teams improve testing efficiency and code quality.
